sentences.text: Arrested Development is an American television sitcom created by Mitchell Hurwitz , which originally aired on Fox for three seasons from November 2 , 2003 to February 10 , 2006 .	Mitchell Hurwitz	Mitchell Hurwitz	Fox	Fox Broadcasting Company	sitcom	sitcom
A fourth season of 15 episodes was released on Netflix on May 26 , 2013 .	Netflix	Netflix
The show follows the fictitious Bluth family , a formerly wealthy and habitually dysfunctional family .	fictitious	fiction	dysfunctional family	dysfunctional family

It is presented in a continuous format , incorporating handheld camera work and voice-over narration , as well as the use of occasional archival photos and historical footage .	continuous format	continuity (fiction)	voice-over	voice-over
The show also utilizes several long-running `` Easter egg '' jokes throughout each season .	Easter egg	Easter egg (media)
Ron Howard serves as both an executive producer and the series ' uncredited narrator .	Ron Howard	Ron Howard
Set in Newport Beach , California , Arrested Development was filmed primarily in Culver City and Marina del Rey .	Culver City	Culver City, California	Marina del Rey	Marina del Rey, California

After its debut in 2003 , the series received widespread critical acclaim , six Primetime Emmy Awards , and one Golden Globe Award , and has attracted a cult following , including several fan-based websites .	Golden Globe Award	Golden Globe Award	cult following	cult following

In 2007 , Time listed the show among its `` All-TIME 100 TV Shows '' ; in 2008 , it was ranked 16th on Entertainment Weekly `` New TV Classics '' list .	Time	Time (magazine)	Entertainment Weekly	Entertainment Weekly
In 2011 , IGN named Arrested Development the `` funniest show of all time '' .	IGN	IGN
Its humor has been cited as a key influence on later single-camera sitcoms such as 30 Rock and Community .	30 Rock	30 Rock	Community	Community (TV series)
Despite critical acclaim , Arrested Development received low ratings and viewership on Fox , which canceled the series in 2006 .	Fox	Fox Broadcasting Company

Rumors of an additional season and a feature film persisted until 2011 , when Netflix agreed to license new episodes and distribute them exclusively on its video streaming service .	Netflix	Netflix	video streaming service	Streaming media
These episodes were later released in 2013 .
Netflix has also commissioned a fifth season of Arrested Development which will premiere in 2018 .	Netflix	Netflix
